android.releaseNotes:
• Fix E2EE Image & Media Decryption: Resolved an issue where received DM image attachments showed blank/white by cleanly preserving media encryption keys (AES-GCM IV & RSA/PQ-Aura recipient keys) in shareData.
• Auto-Download & Background Decryption: Media attachments in direct messages automatically decrypt into local disk cache upon receipt and opening.
• Liquid Glass Modal Sheets & Revamped Context Previews.
• Native Predictive Back Gestures & 120Hz Smooth Scrolling.
